feedback: Approved to race. The candidate is the iteration 5 design (best raced, score 160.41, reproduced in iteration 9) with one geometry change: all five sensors moved forward from y = 0.03 to y = 0.05 m. Controller fields are unchanged (kp 2.5, ki 0.05, kd 0.3, base_speed 1.3, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], search_right). Evidence: iteration 4 (kp 3.0, 83.5), iteration 6 (kd 0.45, 143.1, oval oscillation 0.333), iteration 7 (search_left, 159.1, no measurable change) and iteration 8 (ki 0.10, 109.8, oval finishes 3/20 to 0/20) show gain and line-loss levers are exhausted. Every run since iteration 2 has ended off_track with max_error about 0.060 to 0.063 m, so the sensor position is the untested lever. Approval rests on this being a single valid field change. A revision round would cost two action runs for little extra information, and this is the last full iteration before the final one. The candidate's results are not stated here. Next iteration (final): if this race keeps max_error at or below the iteration 5 values (0.0604 oval, 0.0623 s-bend, 0.0616 slalom), steering_oscillation at or below 0.3 on every track, and line_loss_events at or below 1.3 on the oval and 2.0 on the s-bend, the forward-sensor design is the final choice. If any of these is worse, revert y to 0.03 m and submit the iteration 5 design unchanged, since it is the only verified design above 160. Do not test any further gain change.
requested_changes: If max_error and line_loss_events are at or below the iteration 5 values on all tracks and steering_oscillation stays at or below 0.3: keep geometry.sensor_positions y = 0.05 m for all five sensors and all controller fields at iteration 5 values as the final design.

If max_error rises above the iteration 5 values on any track, or steering_oscillation exceeds 0.3 on any track: revert geometry.sensor_positions y to 0.03 m and submit the iteration 5 design unchanged (kp 2.5, ki 0.05, kd 0.3, base_speed 1.3, sensor_size 0.016, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], search_right).
Do not change any controller gain or line-loss setting in the final iteration. Gain and line-loss levers were tested in iterations 4, 6, 7 and 8 and none beat iteration 5.
